newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Israel Corp rated hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Israel Corp rated hold.

text.p: Bank Hapoalim's securities division, in a report released on Tuesday, rated Israel Corp a hold, citing slim prospects for a significant near-term improvement in its operating results.
"In the short term we do not expect an increase in activities or a significant improvement in the business results of the company," analyst Gil Dor-Hai said.
Israel Corp is a holding company with major interests in Israel Oil Refineries Ltd, Zim Israel Navigation (shipping), Israel Chemicals, Housing and Development Ltd (property) and Tower Semiconductor.

Dor-Hai said Israel Corp would be affected in the near term by an unfavourable exchange rates, which hurt export profits. He also cited softness in key markets for Israel Corp companies -- world shipping, Israeli property and world semiconductors.

Regarding Oil Refineries, Hapoalim expressed concern about the low prices imposed by the government on petroleum prices and uncertaintly regarding the renewal of Oil Refineries' operating licence. The licence expires in the year 2003.
Dor-Hai said he valued Israel Corp at $413.9 million, compared with a market capitalisation of about $306 million, equal to a discount of 26.1 percent.
